requirements.text: On first start, use the current checkout without branches or worktrees, record START, the initial status, and checkpoint CP0 in the ledger, and stop when a task file already has uncommitted changes.
requirements.source: internal-gateway-execute-plans SKILL.md: Checkpoints, Workflow, 2. Set up

requirements.text: On resume, reuse START and the ledger checkpoints instead of git log; continue when a fresh checkpoint matches the latest one or differs only inside the first incomplete task's Files: paths, and otherwise stop for reconciliation without reset or overwrite.

Never commit; record a checkpoint when a task is ready for review and after each fix round, review each task and fix round with checkpoint-to-checkpoint diffs, run the final review from CP0, write ledger lines directly instead of through the imported commit-range helpers, and carry the no-commit contract, perimeter, posture, and stop rules into every subagent brief.
requirements.source: internal-gateway-execute-plans SKILL.md: Checkpoints, Workflow, 3. Run the executor, 5. Finish

requirements.text: Use /superpowers-executing-plans for Native, its alias Inline, or no stated choice, and /superpowers-subagent-driven-development for Subagent-driven.
requirements.source: internal-gateway-execute-plans SKILL.md: Workflow, 1. Select the executor

requirements.text: Stop when HEAD differs from START, a checkpoint diff or required change leaves the Files: perimeter, or a protected imported skill path would change; a ruling never widens the perimeter.
requirements.source: internal-gateway-execute-plans SKILL.md: Approval and perimeter, 4. Stop

requirements.text: Return a plan containing a legacy Execution Manifest to /internal-gateway-writing-plans instead of executing it, with a Next line that asks for re-authoring.
requirements.source: internal-gateway-execute-plans SKILL.md: When not to use

requirements.text: Keep the ledger and report with the four Plan, Changed, Checks, and Next lines plus the rulings and deferred-minor lists.

On first start, check task-file cleanliness, every Depends on check, and Git object write access by writing and reading a new object before any ledger or task edit exists; a successful CP0 over reused objects is not proof, and denied writes stop the run without changing permissions or sandbox policy.

Publish the plan path, START, initial status, and a readable CP0 together through a temporary file renamed to the ledger path, never replace an existing ledger, and stop for reconciliation when an existing ledger lacks a readable checkpoint.
Exclude .superpowers/ and tmp/ from every checkpoint whether or not ignore rules cover them, with every checkpoint command exiting 0, without touching the real index.
Rerun every Depends on check at first start and on resume; results recorded at authoring time are not current evidence, and a failing or unrunnable check stops the run.
requirements.source: internal-gateway-execute-plans SKILL.md: Workflow, 2. Set up, 4. Stop

requirements.text: The Next line names one action that removes the controlling blocker: reconcile the ledger, rerun with writable Git object storage, execute an existing plan by its path, or write a missing plan through /internal-gateway-writing-plans; never a plan named by label alone.
Treat a plan that names another plan as a prerequisite outside a Depends on line as malformed: stop before any ledger or task edit and route it for re-authoring.
Require exclusive use of the checkout and keep the plan and its sources read-only; a change the run did not make stops the run.
requirements.source: internal-gateway-execute-plans SKILL.md: Approval and perimeter, 4. Stop

cases.expected_output: Run the plan through /superpowers-executing-plans under this gateway's setup and stop rules.

fail: The run skips the gateway setup or picks the subagent executor.

cases.expected_output: Continue at Task 2 without the first-start dirty-file stop.

fail: The run reports BLOCKED on Task 1 files.

cases.expected_output: Resume Task 2 on the partial state and note it in the ledger.

pass: Task 2 completes from the partial state with a fresh checkpoint.
fail: The run stops or resets the partial edits.

cases.expected_output: Stop for reconciliation and name the changed path without resetting it.

assertions.text: The run stops before any task edit.
The changed file keeps its current content.

forbidden_actions: Reset, checkout, or overwrite the changed file.

pass: The report is BLOCKED and names the changed Task 1 path.
fail: The run continues or restores CP1.

cases.expected_output: Run the plan and keep the unrelated file out of the final review and the Changed line.

fail: The unrelated file appears in Changed or in the review package.

cases.initial_state: The working tree is clean, so read-tree and write-tree reuse existing objects and succeed, but the host denies writes to the Git object store; no ledger exists.
cases.expected_output: The write-and-read preflight fails, the run stops before any ledger or task edit, and Next asks to rerun with writable Git object storage.

assertions.text: Write access is proven by writing a new object, not by the CP0 result.
No ledger file and no task edit exist after the stop.

forbidden_actions: Treat a successful clean-tree CP0 as proof of write access.
Change file permissions or sandbox policy.

pass: BLOCKED with Next: rerun with writable Git object storage.
fail: The run continues to Task 1 or leaves a partial ledger.

cases.initial_state: No ledger exists; the preflight passes, but git add -A fails while creating CP0.
cases.expected_output: Stop without publishing a ledger, so a later run is still a first start.

assertions.text: No ledger records START without CP0.

forbidden_actions: Publish START before CP0 is readable.

pass: The ledger path does not exist and Checks names the CP0 failure.
fail: A ledger with START and no CP0 remains.

cases.initial_state: An older run left a ledger that names this plan and records START but no CP0.
cases.expected_output: Stop for reconciliation, keep the ledger unchanged, and ask the user to reconcile or remove it.

assertions.text: The ledger is neither reinitialized nor overwritten.

pass: BLOCKED; the ledger path is named for reconciliation.
fail: The run silently restarts or deletes the ledger.

cases.initial_state: The repository does not ignore .superpowers/ or tmp/; the workspace holds cp.idx and the ledger.
cases.expected_output: Every checkpoint excludes .superpowers/ and tmp/ even though no ignore rule covers them.

assertions.text: No checkpoint tree contains cp.idx, the ledger, or tmp/ files.
The real index is unchanged.

forbidden_actions: Write a checkpoint tree without removing the scratch paths.

pass: git diff --name-only between checkpoints lists no scratch path.

cases.initial_state: The plan header has a Depends on line that passed at authoring time and names an existing upstream plan path; the check now fails.
cases.expected_output: Stop before any ledger or task edit and name the upstream plan by path in Next.

assertions.text: The Depends on check is rerun instead of trusting the recorded result.
Next names the upstream plan path and /internal-gateway-execute-plans.

forbidden_actions: Trust the authoring-time result.
Name the upstream plan by label alone.

fail: Task 1 starts or Next says only 'execute Plan B'.

cases.initial_state: The Depends on line marks its producer as unresolved and its check fails.
cases.expected_output: Stop and route Next to writing the missing plan through /internal-gateway-writing-plans.

pass: Next names the writer and the required output.

cases.initial_state: The repository ignores .superpowers/ and tmp/; no ledger exists and the preflight passes.
cases.expected_output: CP0 is created with every checkpoint command exiting 0 and the ledger is published.

assertions.text: No checkpoint command exits non-zero because scratch paths are ignored.

Ignore a non-zero checkpoint exit.

pass: Task 1 starts after a readable CP0.
fail: The run stops with a CP0 failure caused by ignored scratch paths.

fail: The run continues as if the plan had no dependency.
